alternatives_rejected.candidate: checkoutservice: degraded and slowing downstream calls
alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency deviation is far smaller (p90 z=21.15 vs emailservice p90 z=899.74, E1). The inbound latency jump is seen on calls into emailservice (E2), so checkout is a victim waiting on email calls.

CPU saturation would inflate emailservice's own processing time, but its own span self-time p50 stayed flat at 0.19ms (1.04x, E2). Only caller-observed latency rose, which points to network-level delay.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice's pod network path for added latency, such as a tc/netem delay rule or a degraded network link. Remove the rule or reschedule the pod onto a healthy node. Then confirm that checkoutservice-to-emailservice call latency returns to its roughly 3.5ms baseline.
